changes: weekday normalized: 'jñe' (locative of jña = Mercury) = Wednesday (budhavāra)
notes expanded: ce_approx reasoning (ŚS 1777 + 78 = 1855; Phālguna falls early 1856 CE) and reading of trailing 'aeghau śumbha'

notes: The colophon names no persons. ŚS 1777 + 78 = 1855, but Phālguna of Śaka 1777 falls in Feb/Mar 1856 CE, so ce_approx is 1856. 'jñe' is the locative of jña (Mercury), so the day is a Wednesday. The trailing 'aeghau śumbha' looks corrupt. It is probably a garbled closing formula (perhaps a second 'śubham'), not a personal name. The date agrees with the catalogue field (ŚS 1777).
